content: where $\pi $ is the steady-state distribution of the process and $\Pi =\text{diag}(\pi )$ . The element $[R(t,H)]_{\alpha \beta }$ quantifies the probability that a random walker starting from community $\alpha $ will end in community $\beta $ at time $t$ , subtracting the probability that the same event occurs by chance at stationarity.
